No complete restaurant-issued allergen or ingredient matrix was located; menu descriptions support only narrow positive ingredient evidence, with unavailable used for incomplete disclosure.
Cross-contact status is not disclosed on the official homepage or linked Toast menu.

scout.summary: Baan Mae identity and current Washington Toast menu were verified as accessible. The frozen baseline has 28 items, while the current linked Toast catalog has substantial menu drift, including current-only products and baseline-only products. All frozen keys are reconciled exactly once. All current products are defined and linked to one or more menu surfaces. Allergen evidence is incomplete; only explicit positive ingredients are reported, and negative or cross-contact claims remain unavailable. This is a Luna candidate for Terra independent verification.
